scope: One real Codex terminal smoke against the frozen Relay portable gate CLI, using a disposable two-file subject.

gate_sequence.scenario: Codex writes the deliberately incomplete draft.
Codex repairs the draft after gate feedback.
Current receipt controls pass; the deliberately reintroduced earlier subtotal defect fails regression.
Codex restores the accepted contract while preserving the receipt implementation.

verification.relay_repository_byte_inventory: Report before and after inventories matched; the independent live review matched all 195 tracked and 38 nonignored untracked files then present. Git metadata and ignored runtime files were outside that inventory.

independent_live_review.reviewer: OpenCode / openai/gpt-6.1-sol, fresh context distinct from experiment author and pre-reviewer
controls: Independent offline verification, explicit-sprint audit, and five fresh artifact checks.
All four artifact snapshots replayed against the unchanged checker.
Copied negative-validation removal and copied receipt stub rejected.
Unrehashed ledger alteration rejected; changed sprint command produced SPRINT-DIVERGED.

limits: Portable controller loop; native Codex stop-hook binding was not exercised.
Incomplete draft and regression were explicitly requested negative controls, not measured natural model failures or comparative efficacy.
Same-user filesystem and plain SHA-256 evidence provide no adversarial isolation, authenticated authorship, or externally anchored completeness.
Recorded-evidence audit and fresh artifact execution are separate checks.
Raw resume usage counters were retained without assuming per-call token accounting or estimating cost.
Raw evidence resides in a machine-local temporary directory; this record preserves its bounded result and hashes, not the full transcript.
This descriptive JSON record is outside the Markdown hash index and is not a cryptographic signature or runtime review enforcement.
